name: BoostMedia AI Content Generator
author: boostmedia

sections.description:
Boost Content is a WordPress plugin that generates high-quality articles and featured images that match your website’s existing style, structure, and voice. It is a SaaS-based plugin — content generation is performed by the BoostContent backend service, which requires an active account and BoostCoins (credits).

Key Features

  • Smart Scanning — Automatically scans your post types (native, JetEngine, ACF), meta fields, and taxonomies
  • Style Learning — Analyzes your existing content to understand your writing style, tone, and structure
  • AI Article Generation — Creates new articles that match your site’s voice, powered by Google Gemini
  • AI Image Generation — Generates featured images for articles, powered by Google Imagen
  • Plagiarism Checking — Verifies content originality using Copyscape before saving
  • Internal Linking — Deterministic shortcode-based linking system that inserts contextual internal links
  • Full Meta Support — Generates all meta field values, not just body content
  • Scheduling — Schedule generated posts for future publication

How It Works

  1. Scan — The plugin scans your post types and their complete field structure
  2. Analyze — AI analyzes sample posts to learn your writing style and content patterns
  3. Plan — Create a content plan with topics, keywords, and structure preferences
  4. Generate — Articles and images are generated via the BoostContent backend service
  5. Review & Publish — Review generated content, then publish or schedule

Account & Credits

Boost Content is a SaaS plugin. Content generation features require:

  • A registered account (free registration includes starter credits)
  • BoostCoins (credits) — consumed per 100 words of generated content
  • Credits can be purchased or obtained via subscription

The plugin’s WordPress admin interface, link management, and scanning features work without credits.

Perfect For

  • Content-heavy websites with custom post types
  • Sites using JetEngine or ACF for content structure
  • Agencies managing multiple content sites
  • Publishers looking to scale content production while maintaining quality

External Services

This plugin connects to external third-party services to provide its functionality. By using these features, you agree to the respective terms of each service.

BoostContent Backend Service

The plugin connects to the BoostContent backend API (boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il) for AI-powered content generation. This is required for the plugin to function.

Site Registration (on activation):
Data sent: Site domain, WordPress site URL, management key.
When: Once, automatically via WordPress cron after plugin activation.

Content Generation:
Data sent: Post type structure, sample post content (truncated to 2000 chars), reporter configuration, technical rules.
When: When the user initiates content generation.

Link Analysis:
Data sent: Page titles, URLs, page content (truncated to 3000 chars).
When: When the user clicks “Complete with AI” on internal or external links.

Credit Management:
Data sent: Site ID, API key.
When: When checking credit balance or initiating purchases.

AI Chat:
Data sent: Conversation messages, content structure context.
When: During Technical QA and Content Planning conversations.

  • Service URL: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il
  • Terms of Service: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il/privacy

Google Gemini API

Article text generation and research grounding are powered by Google’s Gemini API. Article topics, keywords, and content parameters are sent to Google’s servers for processing.

  • Service: https://ai.google.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Imagen API

Featured image generation is powered by Google’s Imagen API. Image prompts derived from article content are sent to Google’s servers.

  • Service: https://ai.google.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Image Generation & Download

Generated article images are created via Google Imagen through the backend and temporarily hosted on the backend’s CDN. The plugin downloads these images into the WordPress media library.

  • Data sent: None — images are downloaded from the backend, not uploaded.
  • When: After content generation completes, if image generation was enabled.

Copyscape API

When enabled, generated article content is sent to Copyscape’s plagiarism detection service to verify originality before saving.

  • Service: https://www.copyscape.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.copyscape.com/terms.php

PayPal Payment Processing

When purchasing BoostCoins (the plugin’s credit currency), the plugin redirects to PayPal through the BoostContent backend API. PayPal processes the payment — the plugin never handles payment card details directly.

  • Data sent: Package selection, return URLs.
  • When: Only when the user initiates a purchase from the Usage & Costs page.
  • PayPal Terms of Service: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/useragreement-full
  • PayPal Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/privacy-full

Development

The admin interface is built with React and TypeScript, compiled using Vite.

To build from source:

  1. Navigate to the admin/ directory
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies
  3. Run npm run build to compile the production bundle

The compiled output is placed in assets/dist/admin/.

Privacy Policy

BoostMedia AI Content Generator connects to the BoostContent backend service for content generation. Content data (topics, keywords, content plans, sample posts) is sent to the backend, which uses Google Gemini for text generation, Google Imagen for image generation, and Copyscape for plagiarism checking. Payment processing is handled by PayPal when purchasing credits. Generated content is stored locally in your WordPress database. No personal visitor data is collected or transmitted.

For full details, see our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the boost-content folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Boost Content menu in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Configure your settings and connect to the BoostContent service.
  5. Start generating AI-powered content!

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An active BoostContent account (register at the plugin’s settings page)
sections.faq:
What is BoostContent?

BoostContent is an AI-powered content generation plugin that creates research-backed, SEO-optimized articles with internal linking, featured images, and plagiarism checking — all from within your WordPress admin.

How much does it cost?

The plugin itself is free. Content generation uses BoostCoins (1 BoostCoin = ₪1 ILS). A typical article with research, image, and plagiarism checking costs approximately 4-5 BoostCoins. You can purchase BoostCoins through the plugin’s Usage & Costs page.

What AI services does BoostContent use?

BoostContent uses Google Gemini for article generation and research, Google Imagen for featured image creation, and Copyscape for plagiarism verification. All services are documented in the External Services section of this readme.

Does BoostContent support Hebrew?

Yes! BoostContent has full Hebrew and English bilingual support, including RTL layout. The AI reporter can generate content in Hebrew with research from Hebrew and English sources.

Can I regenerate images?

Yes. Each generated article’s image can be regenerated with custom notes. The AI interprets your feedback and generates an improved image that stays relevant to the article’s topic.

How does internal linking work?

BoostContent includes a deterministic post-generation linker. After content is generated, the system automatically inserts contextually relevant internal links using your site’s link inventory. Links are inserted as shortcodes that resolve to real HTML links on the frontend.

Is the generated content original?

BoostContent integrates Copyscape plagiarism checking. Each article is checked against the web and a private index (to prevent self-plagiarism across your own articles). Articles that exceed the similarity threshold are automatically rewritten.

Do I need JetEngine?

No. Boost Content works with native WordPress post types, JetEngine custom post types, and ACF fields. JetEngine integration provides the deepest field scanning.

Can I schedule generated posts?

Yes. You can publish immediately, save as draft, or schedule for a future date.

  • Scheduling — Schedule generated posts for future publication

How It Works

  1. Scan — The plugin scans your post types and their complete field structure
  2. Analyze — AI analyzes sample posts to learn your writing style and content patterns
  3. Plan — Create a content plan with topics, keywords, and structure preferences
  4. Generate — Articles and images are generated via the BoostContent backend service
  5. Review & Publish — Review generated content, then publish or schedule

Account & Credits

Boost Content is a SaaS plugin. Content generation features require:

  • A registered account (free registration includes starter credits)
  • BoostCoins (credits) — consumed per 100 words of generated content
  • Credits can be purchased or obtained via subscription

The plugin’s WordPress admin interface, link management, and scanning features work without credits.

Perfect For

  • Content-heavy websites with custom post types
  • Sites using JetEngine or ACF for content structure
  • Agencies managing multiple content sites
  • Publishers looking to scale content production while maintaining quality

External Services

This plugin connects to external third-party services to provide its functionality. By using these features, you agree to the respective terms of each service.

BoostContent Backend Service

The plugin connects to the BoostContent backend API (boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il) for AI-powered content generation. This is required for the plugin to function.

Site Registration (on activation):
Data sent: Site domain, WordPress site URL, management key.
When: Once, automatically via WordPress cron after plugin activation.

Content Generation:
Data sent: Post type structure, sample post content (truncated to 2000 chars), reporter configuration, technical rules.
When: When the user initiates content generation.

Link Analysis:
Data sent: Page titles, URLs, page content (truncated to 3000 chars).
When: When the user clicks “Complete with AI” on internal or external links.

Credit Management:
Data sent: Site ID, API key.
When: When checking credit balance or initiating purchases.

AI Chat:
Data sent: Conversation messages, content structure context.
When: During Technical QA and Content Planning conversations.

  • Service URL: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il
  • Terms of Service: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://boostcontent.boostmedia.co.il/privacy

Google Gemini API

Article text generation and research grounding are powered by Google’s Gemini API. Article topics, keywords, and content parameters are sent to Google’s servers for processing.

  • Service: https://ai.google.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Imagen API

Featured image generation is powered by Google’s Imagen API. Image prompts derived from article content are sent to Google’s servers.

  • Service: https://ai.google.dev
  • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Image Generation & Download

Generated article images are created via Google Imagen through the backend and temporarily hosted on the backend’s CDN. The plugin downloads these images into the WordPress media library.

  • Data sent: None — images are downloaded from the backend, not uploaded.
  • When: After content generation completes, if image generation was enabled.

Copyscape API

When enabled, generated article content is sent to Copyscape’s plagiarism detection service to verify originality before saving.

  • Service: https://www.copyscape.com
  • Terms of Service: https://www.copyscape.com/terms.php

PayPal Payment Processing

When purchasing BoostCoins (the plugin’s credit currency), the plugin redirects to PayPal through the BoostContent backend API. PayPal processes the payment — the plugin never handles payment card details directly.

  • Data sent: Package selection, return URLs.
  • When: Only when the user initiates a purchase from the Usage & Costs page.
  • PayPal Terms of Service: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/useragreement-full
  • PayPal Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/privacy-full

Development

The admin interface is built with React and TypeScript, compiled using Vite.

To build from source:

  1. Navigate to the admin/ directory
  2. Run npm install to install dependencies
  3. Run npm run build to compile the production bundle

The compiled output is placed in assets/dist/admin/.

Privacy Policy

BoostMedia AI Content Generator connects to the BoostContent backend service for content generation. Content data (topics, keywords, content plans, sample posts) is sent to the backend, which uses Google Gemini for text generation, Google Imagen for image generation, and Copyscape for plagiarism checking. Payment processing is handled by PayPal when purchasing credits. Generated content is stored locally in your WordPress database. No personal visitor data is collected or transmitted.

For full details, see our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
